title: Clap and Pause · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Clap and Pause · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a four-beat pattern made of claps and pauses. The lead performs the pattern once and a partner repeats it. The partner matches all four beats. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Clap and Pause, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The partner matches all four beats.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The partner matches all four beats.
